subject: Banking
title: Credit Suisse: 167 Years to Fall
description: One-minute skill: Credit Suisse: 167 Years to Fall.

hook.text: Credit Suisse survived two world wars and multiple crises. In 2023, it collapsed and was absorbed by rival UBS.

buildup.text: Years of scandals eroded trust: Archegos losses, Greensill exposure, money laundering fines.

discovery.text: Customers withdrew $119 billion in the fourth quarter of 2022 alone. For a bank, customer flight is a death sentence.

twist.text: The Swiss government forced UBS to buy Credit Suisse over a weekend.

climax.text: Credit Suisse proved that reputation is a bank's most valuable asset.

punchline.text: 167 years old. $119 billion withdrawn. Absorbed by a rival in a weekend.

quiz.question: What ultimately caused Credit Suisse's downfall?
options: Years of scandals that destroyed customer trust
